title: Unlocking Compositional Generalization in Continual Few-Shot Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.11710v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Object-centric representations promise a key property for few-shot learning: Rather than treating a scene as a single unit, a model can decompose it into individual object-level parts that can be matched and compared across different concepts. In practice, this potential is rarely realized. Continual learners either collapse scenes into global embeddings, or train with part-level matching objectives that tie representations too closely to seen patterns, leaving them unable to generalize to truly novel concepts. In this paper, we identify this fundamental structural conflict and pioneer a new paradigm that strictly decouples representation learning from compositional inference. Leveraging the inherent patch-level semantic geometry of self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs), our framework employs a dual-phase strategy. translated_title: 在持续小样本学习中解锁组合泛化能力
translated_abstract: 以对象为中心的表示为小样本学习提供了一个关键特性：模型无需将场景视为单一整体，而是可以将其分解为对象级别的各个部分，从而在不同概念之间进行匹配与比较。但在实践中，这一潜力很少被真正实现。持续学习器要么将场景坍缩为全局嵌入，要么采用将表示与已见模式绑定过紧的部分级匹配目标进行训练，导致其无法泛化到真正新颖的概念。在本文中，我们识别了这一根本性的结构冲突，并开创了一种将表示学习与组合推理严格解耦的新范式。我们的框架利用自监督视觉Transformer（ViT）固有的补丁级语义几何结构，采用双阶段策略：在训练阶段，槽位表示完全朝向整体类别身份进行优化，从而保留了高度通（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文识别了持续小样本学习中表示学习与组合推理之间的根本结构冲突，并提出一种严格解耦二者的双阶段新范式，借助自监督ViT的补丁级语义几何，实现对真正新颖概念的组合泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the fundamental structural conflict between representation learning and compositional inference in continual few-shot learning, and pioneers a new dual-phase paradigm that strictly decouples the two, leveraging the patch-level semantic geometry of self-supervised ViTs to generalize to truly novel concepts.
